result.question: Quais são os 10 municípios com maior taxa de mortalidade em internações obstétricas, entre aqueles com mais de 200 internações obstétricas e taxa acima da média nacional obstétrica?
result.gold_sql:
WITH media_obs AS (
    SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_media_obstetrica
    FROM internacoes i
    WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2
)
SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS nome,
       mu."SG_UF" AS estado,
       COUNT(*) AS total_obstetrico,
       SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_mort_obstetrica,
       ROUND(mo.taxa_media_obstetrica, 4) AS media_nacional
FROM internacoes i
JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D", media_obs mo
WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2
GROUP BY mu."NO_MUNICIPIO", mu."SG_UF", mo.taxa_media_obstetrica
HAVING COUNT(*) > 200
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > mo.taxa_media_obstetrica
ORDER BY taxa_mort_obstetrica DESC
LIMIT 10;
